towardGoal: Green: Two from Rondo enter the attack — forward w/ pace
Blue: One from each rondo box tracks back to defend (6 & fullback) — man mark
rondoAction: Green: Defending rondo... If they win it, they go towards goal
Blue: Simple rondo, X passes & pass into mini goals

phases.name: Phase 1: Rondo Action (4v2)
phases.note: Blue circulates in the 7x7 rondo (X passes → score in mini goals). Green presses 2v4.

phases.name: Phase 2: Green Wins Possession
phases.note: Green (#10) intercepts inside the left rondo box and looks forward immediately.

phases.name: Phase 3: Two Enter Attack w/ Pace
phases.note: Both Green rondo players burst forward into the attack. One Blue from each box (#6 & fullback) triggers recovery.

phases.name: Phase 4: Recovery & Man Marking
phases.note: Blue #6 and fullback track back to man-mark the late Green runners. Green plays at tempo.

phases.name: Phase 5: Finish on Goal
phases.note: Green attacks the box with 5 players for a decisive finish. Next rep: switch to right rondo box!

rondoAction: Players w/ balls play ground pass into player in middle
Player checks around the mannequin, 1st touch diagonal & plays the other side
generalNotes: Different # of touches & different kinds of passes
Progress w/: give & go, lobbed passes, complete freedom

phases.name: Phase 1: Check Around Mannequins
phases.note: Middle Blue and Red players check away around their mannequins into the central pocket.

phases.name: Phase 2: Ground Pass to Middle
phases.note: Top-right Red plays diagonal ground pass into checking Red; bottom Red plays into checking Blue.

phases.name: Phase 3: Diagonal Touch & Play Opposite
phases.note: Middle receivers take a diagonal touch and pass across to the opposite corner cone.

phases.name: Phase 4: Follow Your Pass
phases.note: Passers sprint to replace the central mannequin spots; receivers follow their pass to the corner.

rondoAction: Player with the ball plays to the stick
Player at the mannequin checks away to the stick, then turns

phases.name: Phase 1: Mannequin Setup
phases.note: Server starts at the bottom cone with the ball; receiver holds tight to the right mannequin.

phases.name: Phase 2: Check Away & Pass to Stick
phases.note: Receiver checks away outside the red stick while server drives a crisp pass toward the stick.

phases.name: Phase 3: Turn & Drive Upfield
phases.note: Receiver turns cleanly around the stick and accelerates diagonally toward the top 11-yd cone.

phases.name: Phase 4: Finish at Top Cone & Rotate
phases.note: Receiver reaches the top cone; server moves up to the mannequin for the next rep (alternate left/right).

rondoAction: Player w/ the ball passes clean to player in box
Player receives the ball & central turn out of the box
Dribbles back to same side cone w/ ball
generalNotes: Only one player in the box at a time, sides should alternate
Progress to give & go's (check in, check out)

phases.name: Phase 1: Top Pass Into Box (Green)
phases.note: Top Green server passes cleanly into the Green player inside the tight 3x3 cone box.

phases.name: Phase 2: Central Turn & Escape (Green)
phases.note: Green executes a central turn out the right side of the box and dribbles back to the top cone.

phases.name: Phase 3: Alternate Side — Bottom Pass (Blue)
phases.note: Only one player in the box at a time: Blue steps in and receives the clean pass from bottom Blue.

phases.name: Phase 4: Central Turn & Escape (Blue)
phases.note: Blue turns out the left side of the box and dribbles back to the bottom cone at high tempo.

towardGoal: Break line to forwards, then score
Defense: Shift, then recovery run to defend shots
generalNotes: Creativity, dummy runs, intensity, quick shots

phases.name: Phase 1: Zone Shape & Shifting
phases.note: Teams hold their horizontal zones. Blue shifts laterally to screen passing lanes; Red looks to break lines.

phases.name: Phase 2: Break Line to Forwards
phases.note: Red #8 splits the 4-player Blue line with a vertical pass into Red #10 in the top zone.

phases.name: Phase 3: Recovery Run & Quick Shot
phases.note: Blue defenders sprint back to block while Red #9 strikes one-touch on the Purple keeper.
